segments.text: August 27, 2024 — As recorded in the meeting minutes:

. Mr. Merrill expressed two concerns he has regarding bike lanes on 200 South. After the construction on the intersection on 200 South, a nice shoulder was included on the way to the FrontRunner Station. It gave people a lot of space to ride their bikes, however, for several weeks there have been cars parked there. With the cars in that shoulder area, those on bikes now have to go into the lane of travel, which is a safety concern. He asked that the city not allow parking there. Additionally, on 200 South where bike lanes had been marked, after it was repaved the bike lanes were no repainted. He asked the city to implement the bicycle master plan as approved.
